observations: Revised prose uses normal chapter typography and paragraph separation; inline math and citations wrap without new collisions in inspected views.

Mechanism labels, state explanations, counters, captions, and controls remain legible in inspected states. Narrow timeline views provide textual task legends when bars are too short for inline labels.

Desktop mechanism capture clips include the fixed site banner over their top introductory edge; visible core controls and mechanism content remain unobstructed. This is recorded as a capture-scope limitation, not a newly attributed product defect.
limits: This is a manual review of the supplied screenshot frames, not a new full interaction or numerical audit.
No dark-theme, PDF, EPUB, or full-section scrolling verification was performed in this pass.
Some screenshot edges truncate surrounding paragraphs or earlier figure artwork because captures are viewport/element clips; no claim is made to inspecting unseen context.
Existing runtime, motion, case, art-identity, and automated mounting checks are separate evidence and were not rerun by this reviewer.
